scholarships.title: University of Turku Merit Scholarship and Early Bird Discount

existing.description: Since the 2026 intake the University of Turku no longer offers a scholarship that covers the first year of tuition. Instead it offers an automatic EUR 2,000 Early Bird discount to newly admitted master's students who accept the offer and pay within 28 days of the admission decision, and the University of Turku Merit Scholarship, which covers 50% of the tuition fee for the following study year. The merit scholarship is based on studies completed at the University of Turku and requires 55 ECTS in the first study year, an average score of at least 3.0, and at least 4 ECTS of Finnish, with a separate application opened in spring.
eligibility: Admitted to a University of Turku bachelor's or master's programme and liable to pay tuition fees, i.e. a citizen of a country outside the EU, EEA or Switzerland
Has paid for their studies during the first year or years at the University of Turku
Completed 55 ECTS in the first study year (110 ECTS across two years for the third year of a bachelor's)
Average score of 3.0 or higher on the 1-5 grading scale
Completed at least 4 ECTS of Finnish before applying for the first time
For the Early Bird discount: a newly admitted master's applicant who accepts the study offer and pays the tuition fee within 28 days of the admission decision
existing.eligibility_summary: Fee-paying degree students at the University of Turku who have completed at least 55 ECTS in their first study year with an average score of 3.0 or higher and at least 4 ECTS of Finnish. Newly admitted master's students may take up the EUR 2,000 Early Bird discount.
benefits: 50% of the second year tuition fee for master's students
50% of the second and third year tuition fees for bachelor's students
EUR 2,000 Early Bird discount for newly admitted master's students
coverage: 50% of the tuition fee for the next study year
EUR 2,000 Early Bird discount on the first year for master's applicants
documents: Application for the merit scholarship when invited by the admission services
application_method: Merit Scholarship: separate application after an invitation from the admission services in spring
Early Bird discount: no application, automatic on acceptance and payment within 28 days
existing.selection_notes: All students who fulfil the requirements are awarded the scholarship; it is not a competitive award but a merit threshold. The Early Bird discount is automatic for all newly admitted master's students who meet the payment condition.
existing.best_fit: Students applying for pre-2026 intake at University of Turku (needs_review for 2026+)
existing.notes: The scholarship system was changed for the 2026 intake: no scholarship can cover the first year tuition fee, and the previous system of full-tuition two- or three-year scholarships no longer applies. Students admitted in 2025 or earlier follow the older scheme.
existing.duration: One academic year at a time; the merit scholarship is awarded for the following academic year and must be reapplied for
existing.deadline_display: "There is a separate application process for the merit scholarships. The admission services of the University will invite all eligible applicants to apply for the scholarship when the application round opens in spring." For the Early Bird discount the deadline is relative: "the applicant must accept the study offer and pay the tuition fee within 28 days after the admission decisions have been published."
existing.program_type: Merit-based tuition fee waiver awarded during studies, plus an automatic first-year tuition discount
